findings.title: Shard-split queries are interpolated twice
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery() now interpolates every target with datasource.applyTemplateVariables(query, request.scopedVars, request.filters), but each resulting sub-request is then passed to runSplitQuery() (shardQuerySplitting.ts:163), which after this PR interpolates the same targets again with the same scopedVars/filters (querySplitting.ts:299). applyTemplateVariables is not an idempotent no-op: it performs template replacement and applies ad-hoc filters from request.filters, so a second pass can duplicate ad-hoc label/filter injection into an already-filtered LogQL expression (potentially producing duplicate matchers/filters or invalid LogQL) and can re-expand '$' sequences introduced by the first expansion (e.g. variable/label values containing '$'), corrupting the expression. The updated test even encodes this by expecting applyTemplateVariables to be called 5 times for one original target. Interpolate only once: either let shard splitting do the pre-shard interpolation and have runSplitQuery accept already-interpolated targets/skip re-interpolation, or remove the duplicate work while preserving the interpolation needed before fetchLabelValues/getSelectorForShardValues.

findings.title: Empty-expression filtering now happens before interpolation in shard splitting
findings.body: The previous code interpolated all targets first (interpolateVariablesInQueries) and only then filtered out empty/hidden queries, so a target whose expr is a variable that expands to an empty string was dropped. The new code filters on the raw pre-interpolation expr (lines 50-52) and never re-checks after applyTemplateVariables, so a variable-backed expr that interpolates to '' is retained and flows into requestSupportsSharding/getSelectorForShardValues/fetchLabelValues and query execution as an empty LogQL query, instead of being ignored like empty queries elsewhere. Move the emptiness check (or add a second one) after interpolation in runShardSplitQuery.
